label: Python with mypy
description: Type checks Python components with mypy and the project own configuration. Comes in by evidence: only when mypy is configured (mypy.ini, .mypy.ini, [tool.mypy] in pyproject.toml, [mypy] in setup.cfg or tox.ini). mypy is supplied by the project environment and is never installed during a run. Extends python-mypy-defaults (same mypy instance): where both are active, this one wins and the check is required, with the project's configuration only.
